company.en: NetEase Games — Knives Out Business Unit

bullets.zh: 完善光追组件，构建 Path Tracer 作为引擎的标准光照能量参考，添加对自发光光源的采样支持。
bullets.en: Enhanced the ray-tracing component by building a path tracer as the engine's global illumination reference and adding emissive-light sampling.

bullets.zh: 拓展 GPU Lightmass 功能，支持 World Composition 场景中的分区烘焙，从而降低峰值显存与内存占用，提升大规模场景的烘焙效率与稳定性。
bullets.en: Extended GPU Lightmass to support partitioned baking for World Composition scenes, reducing peak VRAM and memory usage while improving baking efficiency and stability for large-scale scenes.

bullets.zh: 在 UE5 中复现 RTXGI 2 中的 SHaRC，以代替 Lumen 中的 Surface Cache 作为世界空间的 Radiance Cache。
bullets.en: Reimplemented SHaRC from RTXGI 2 in UE5 to replace Lumen's surface cache as a world-space radiance cache.

bullets.zh: 通过实验分析，评估两种缓存系统的优缺点，为优化游戏引擎中的 Radiance Cache 提供依据。
bullets.en: Conducted controlled experiments to compare the two cache systems, quantify trade-offs, and guide radiance cache optimization.

title.zh: SRSSIS: Super-Resolution Screen Space Irradiance Sampling for Lightweight Collaborative Web3D Rendering Architecture
title.en: SRSSIS: Super-Resolution Screen Space Irradiance Sampling for Lightweight Collaborative Web3D Rendering Architecture

bullets.zh: 提出一种基于超分辨率的协同式渲染架构。
bullets.en: Proposed a super-resolution-based collaborative rendering architecture.

bullets.zh: 实现 Vulkan/Slang GPU Neural Appearance 训练器，学习材质的漫反射与镜面反射响应。
bullets.en: Implemented a Vulkan/Slang GPU Neural Appearance trainer for diffuse and specular material responses.

bullets.zh: 基于 C++26 模块、Slang 与 Vulkan 1.4 构建渲染器，集成路径追踪与 DLSS Ray Reconstruction。
bullets.en: Built a Vulkan 1.4 research renderer with C++26 modules and Slang, integrating path tracing and DLSS Ray Reconstruction.

bullets.zh: 设计跨帧多队列渲染依赖图，自动推导资源屏障、布局与队列所有权，使图形、计算和传输任务可重叠执行。
bullets.en: Designed a cross-frame, multi-queue render dependency graph that derives resource barriers, layouts, and queue ownership to overlap graphics, compute, and transfer work.

bullets.zh: 在 WebGPU 上构建了混合渲染管线，其中包含 V-buffer、光线追踪、降噪、超分辨率四个模块。
bullets.en: Built a hybrid rendering pipeline on WebGPU with V-buffer, ray tracing, denoising, and super-resolution modules.

bullets.zh: 在光线追踪模块中，使用基于 SAH 的 BVH 作为加速结构，复现 ReSTIR DI & GI 实现实时全局光照，结合 SVGF 和 ReLAX 实现降噪模块。
bullets.en: Implemented an SAH-based BVH, reproduced ReSTIR DI & GI for real-time global illumination, and integrated SVGF and ReLAX for denoising.

bullets.zh: 从属于基于 UE5 Lumen 的协同式渲染系统项目，负责在项目初期提供代替 Lumen 输出 Screen Probe 的接口，用于测试协同式渲染系统。
bullets.en: For a collaborative rendering system based on UE5 Lumen, delivered an early alternative interface for outputting screen probes to test the rendering pipeline.

bullets.zh: 基于 Vulkan 的硬件光线追踪管线。
bullets.en: Implemented on a Vulkan hardware ray-tracing pipeline.

bullets.zh: 基于 Vulkan，在实例化场景中预计算每个采样点的可见物体集合及其权重，从而计算每个单元格内的可见集。
bullets.en: In instanced Vulkan scenes, precomputed each sample point's visible-object set and weights to form per-cell visibility sets.

bullets.zh: 可见性体积用于辅助在前端实时加载模型时的调度传输。
bullets.en: Used visibility volumes to aid scheduling and streaming during real-time client-side model loading.
